newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 3.9 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 3.9 pct in March.

text.p: Sao Paulo state's industrial activity rose 3.9 percent in March, compared with same period the year before, the Sao Paulo state industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
March industrial activity, however, dropped 1.1 percent when compared with the previous month.
Industrial sales rose 8.3 percent in March against the same month in 1996 but fell 1.5 percent when compared with February 1997 figures, it added.
